name: Starke County, Indiana (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and navy blue charged with a yellow map of Indiana, over which a white outline of Starke County bears the date 1850, the name Starke in red and a ring of red and blue stars.
history: Starke County is a county in Indiana. The flag was adopted on 10 October 2016 (unveiled at the state bicentennial torch relay and first raised over the courthouse on 10 October 2016, presented to the county by Melba and Brad Shilling in memory of Jim Shilling and sketched by his granddaughter Kaylee Crom, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of Indiana with an outline of Starke County bearing 1850 and the name Starke
ring of red and blue stars on the county outline
